decision_point_branch_models.description: Decision-point-level branch model. Each Petri-net decision point is represented by one multi-branch decision tree or empirical branch distribution.

modular_params.modeling_description: Five-module white-box process simulation model with preprocessing, decision-point control flow, inter-arrival distribution, dynamic resource service model, and queue scheduling.

preprocessing.description: Log loading, log-model alignment, enabled-time computation, resource-state reconstruction, and queue-state reconstruction.

decision_point_branch_models.description: Decision-point-level branch model. Each Petri-net decision point is represented by one multi-branch decision tree or empirical branch distribution.

sampling.note: wall_clock_minutes preserves long no-arrival gaps and avoids compressing case arrivals through the arrival calendar

intensity_trend.interpretation: forecast_multiplier > 1 means future case arrivals are slower; < 1 means future case arrivals are denser. The multiplier is learned only from the discovery log, not from validation/test data.

runtime_guard.interpretation: delta_cap_min is a runtime safety cap learned from the discovery log. It prevents extreme sampled inter-arrival values and pandas timestamp overflow; it is not validation/test calibration.

regularization.purpose: lengthen short context/fallback buckets and reduce weekday fallback short-gap bias

base_service_time_distributions.description: Base service-time distributions for activity-resource pairs. Sparse pairs fall back to activity-level distributions. Dynamic resource DBN adjusts sampled base service times at runtime.

resource_state_dbn.description: A discrete two-slice dynamic Bayesian network for resource-state evolution. The DBN learns conditional transition probabilities from resource-level state-transition samples.

resource_selection.note: This factor is learned from the states of actually selected resources. For a stricter resource-choice model, construct chosen/not-chosen samples from enabled resource sets.

queue_scheduling_model.description: A single global queue-scheduling tree over task-resource pairs. It replaces DBPS resource-selection and waiting-time trees.
feature_columns: activity = Homologacion por grupo de cursos

false.feature: activity = Homologacion por grupo de cursos

metadata.modeling_note: Queue scheduling is learned from task-resource candidate pairs. No legacy per-resource selection tree or waiting-time tree is used.

external_delay_model.description: External start-delay model for non-resource waiting. The queue scheduler determines resource-competition waiting; this model adds a shallow activity-level probabilistic tree for residual start delays.
